Symbols:
  T_{s_{out}}: shell-side outlet temperature (computed)
  \varepsilon: heat exchanger effectiveness [—] (parameter)
  T_{t_{in}}: tube-side inlet temperature (catalyst bed 3 outlet) (variable)
  T_{s_{in}}: shell-side inlet temperature (variable)
  X_{r,b}: reactant conversion in catalyst bed b [-] (computed)
  v_{r}: stoichiometric factor relating ammonia formation rate to reactant conversion [-] (parameter)
  R_{NH_3,b}: ammonia formation rate in catalyst bed b (variable)
  \dot{n}_{r,b_{in}}: molar flow rate of reactant entering catalyst bed b (variable)
  T_{b}: temperature of the fine catalyst particles in bed b (computed)
  \Delta H_{b}: reaction enthalpy for catalyst bed b (parameter)
  \dot{m}_{b_{in}}: Mass flow rate entering catalyst bed b. (variable)
  c_{p_b}: Heat capacity of the stream in catalyst bed b. (parameter)
  R_{NH_3}: Rate of reaction. [kmol m^-3 h^-1] (computed)
  k_{2}: Constant for the reverse reaction. (parameter)
  K: Equilibrium constant of the reaction. [bar^-2] (parameter)
  a_{N_2}: Nitrogen activity coefficient. [-] (variable)
  a_{H_2}: Hydrogen activity coefficient. [-] (variable)
  a_{NH_3}: Ammonia activity coefficient. [-] (variable)
  \alpha: Exponent in the Temkin reaction-rate expression. [-] (parameter)
  X_{r,m_{out}}: Reactant conversion at the mixer outlet after quenching. [-] (computed)
  X_{r,b_{out}}: Reactant conversion at the bed outlet. [-] (variable)
  \dot{n}_{r,b_{out}}: Reactant molar flow rate at the bed outlet. (variable)
  \dot{n}_{r,q_{in}}: Reactant molar flow rate entering the quench. (variable)
  T_{m_{out}}: Temperature after quenching at the mixer outlet. (computed)
  \dot{m}_{b_{out}}: Mass flow rate leaving the bed. (variable)
  C_{p_{b_{out}}}: Specific heat capacity of the stream leaving the bed. (parameter)
  T_{b_{out}}: Temperature of the stream leaving the bed. (variable)
  \dot{m}_{q_{in}}: Mass flow rate entering the quench. (variable)
  C_{p_{q_{in}}}: Specific heat capacity of the quench-inlet stream. (parameter)
  T_{q_{in}}: Temperature of the stream entering the quench. (variable)
  C_{p_{m_{out}}}: Specific heat capacity of the mixed outlet stream [J kg^-1 K^-1] (parameter)

Model-wide assumptions (already recorded, do not repeat):
  - The reactor is represented by a pseudo-homogeneous model.
  - Heat losses are ignored.
  - The reactor system is isobaric.
  - The temperature gradient inside catalyst pellets is negligible.
  - Gas mixing in the mixer is ideal and instantaneous.
  - During normal operation, 27.79 mol% of NH₃ is carried along with the recycled unused reactants.
